# nah_policy_binding (Data Source)

Reads a NahCloud policy_binding.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nah_policy_binding" "automation" {
  policy_id = "POLICY_ID"
  id        = "BINDING_ID"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `policy_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `org_id` (String) Opaque organization ID.
- `principal_id` (String) Principal ID.
- `principal_type` (String) Principal type.
- `target_id` (String) Target ID.
- `target_type` (String) Target type.
